g.text: 然后转到第一个光滑皮带轮，
再绕过 GT2 皮带轮，
然后绕过另一个光滑皮带轮，
最后将皮带绕过左侧惰轮。
a) Route the belt around the right idler pulley
then go to the first smooth pulley
then go under the GT2 pulley
and then go back around the other smooth pulley,
and finally route the belt around the left idler pulley.

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'5',"0247_M4x6 socket Button head cap screw")
